project.name: msc-modelvalidators
project.description: Aggregator for this thesis's model-validator work: the crisp Kodkod baseline (kk-modelvalidator), the benchmark tooling that measures it (benchmark), and the thesis's own contribution, the uncertainty-aware model validator (unc-modelvalidator, not yet started -- named for "uncertain" rather than a specific backend, since Z3 is the pinned first SMT solver but not necessarily the only one ever). Grouped together because all three share one concern -- finding/validating bounded object models for USE/OCL specifications -- and the benchmark module is designed to measure either backend without modification.
